method: The first run is the published single-run snapshot. Two additional whole uninstrumented processes were predeclared after the first high-lights sweep fell outside the tolerance band. Each has both 20 repeated inputs and 20 one-time distinct inputs for every control. The pool retains all three whole processes, 60 samples per control per phase. LightFlow has its original 20 samples per control and phase. Both use nearest-rank p95.

instrumentedDiagnostic.method: For every unique slider input, join the host acquisition time (fingerprint, pool lock and actual acquire, including GPU wait only on fill) to its measured complete RGBA8 readback. The general timing trace writes to stderr. These instrumented values are not pooled with release measurements.
